newsitem.title: USA: Raven Industries buys storage tank firm.
newsitem.headline: Raven Industries buys storage tank firm.

text.p: Raven Industries Inc said Thursday it acquired Norcore Plastics Inc of Tacoma, Wash., for slightly more than $3.0 million, with one-third being in cash and two-thirds paid in stock.
Norcore makes large industrial storage tanks utilizing dual laminate technology.
Raven said it believes this acquisition will give its plastic tank business a "strong boost."

"Norcore is a profitable company with sales in the $8-$9 million range and brings to Raven an additional technology for its present industrial tank market as well as a West Coast location, which the company has been seeking," David Christensen, president, said in a statement.
Raven Industries is a diversified manufacturer that supplies plastics, electronics and special-apparel products to various markets.
